# Accident Claims Scotland

Accident Claims Scotland is a marketing and information website about personal injury and compensation claims in Scotland. It is not currently presented as a regulated law firm. Content is general information, not individual legal advice.

## Core guides

- Personal injury claims: https://www.accident-claims-scotland.com/personal-injury-claims-scotland
- Road traffic accidents: https://www.accident-claims-scotland.com/road-traffic-accident-claims-scotland
- Accidents at work: https://www.accident-claims-scotland.com/accident-at-work-claims-scotland
- Public place accidents: https://www.accident-claims-scotland.com/public-place-accident-claims-scotland
- Medical negligence: https://www.accident-claims-scotland.com/medical-negligence-claims-scotland
- Serious injury: https://www.accident-claims-scotland.com/serious-injury-claims-scotland
- Industrial disease: https://www.accident-claims-scotland.com/industrial-disease-claims-scotland
- Criminal injury and CICA: https://www.accident-claims-scotland.com/criminal-injury-compensation-scotland

## Essential claims information

- Claims process: https://www.accident-claims-scotland.com/how-to-claim-compensation-scotland
- Personal injury time limits: https://www.accident-claims-scotland.com/personal-injury-claim-time-limits-scotland
- Compensation: https://www.accident-claims-scotland.com/personal-injury-compensation-scotland
- No win, no fee: https://www.accident-claims-scotland.com/no-win-no-fee-solicitors-scotland
- Article library: https://www.accident-claims-scotland.com/guides

## Interpretation notes

- The website focuses on Scots law and should not be treated as guidance for England, Wales or Northern Ireland.
- Civil personal injury claims, CICA applications, clinical negligence, industrial disease and fatal claims are distinct routes.
- Time limits and eligibility depend on the facts. Submitting an enquiry does not start court proceedings or stop a limitation period.
- Outcomes, compensation, funding and case acceptance are not guaranteed.
